---
title: Structured elements in Typst
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: mono
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: Callouts of each kind, a task list, keys, details, a theorem, a proof and maths compile to a PDF/UA-1 file in the mono preset, whose fonts have no ballot box glyphs, with the task states and the TeX source of the maths as alternative texts.
        check: bash _checks/accessibility.sh elements
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['#metadata\(\(mc-callout: "warning", appearance: "simple", titled: true\)\)', '#mc-task-list\[', '#mc-task\(true\)', '#mc-task\(false\)', '#mc-kbd\[', '#mc-details\(', '#math\.equation\(block: false, alt: "E = mc\^2", ', '#math\.equation\(block: true, alt: "\\\\sum_\{n=1\}\^3 n = 6"']
---

::: {.callout-note}
## Titled note
A note with `inline code`.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
A tip with no title.
:::

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
## Simple warning
Body of a simple warning.
:::

::: {.callout-caution appearance="minimal"}
Minimal caution.
:::

::: {#nte-cross .callout-note}
## Cross-referenced note
See @nte-cross.
:::

- [x] Done task
- [ ] Open task

Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>.

<details>
<summary>More</summary>

Inside the details.

</details>

:::

:::
